project_type: React SPA with Supabase backend, Vite build, TypeScript strict mode
build_system: Vite with pnpm package manager. Uses @tailwindcss/vite plugin. Path alias @/ -> ./src/
test_framework: No test framework installed - verification is via pnpm build (tsc + vite build)
verification_instructions: Run 'pnpm build' which runs 'tsc -b && vite build'. Must produce zero TypeScript errors and a successful vite bundle.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. pnpm is available. Node.js available. Can install npm packages.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters). Build must pass with zero errors.

key_patterns.routing: React Router v7 with lazy-loaded pages in src/App.tsx. Public routes (login, register, forgot-password) outside AuthGuard. Protected routes inside AuthGuard > AppShell.
key_patterns.auth: AuthContext in src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx provides login/signup/logout/resetPassword/loginWithOAuth. useAuth hook in src/hooks/useAuth.ts. AuthGuard redirects to /login if not authenticated.
key_patterns.forms: react-hook-form + zod validation. Multi-step forms with separate schemas per step.
key_patterns.ui_components: Radix UI primitives in src/components/ui/ (button, input, label, select, dialog, etc.). shadcn/ui pattern with class-variance-authority.
key_patterns.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with dark theme. Glass morphism cards (class 'glass'). Gradient orbs for backgrounds. 24px border-radius on cards. Primary color: emerald (#10b981).
key_patterns.animations: motion/react (framer-motion v12+) for page transitions and component animations.
key_patterns.state: React Query for server state. React Context for auth and sidebar state.
key_patterns.database_types: src/types/database.ts has Profile interface with id, email, full_name, avatar_url, role_id, branch_id, phone, is_active, created_at, updated_at.
key_patterns.toasts: sonner library installed for toast notifications.

directory_structure: src/pages/auth/ - auth pages. src/components/auth/ - AuthGuard. src/components/ui/ - reusable UI primitives. src/components/layout/ - AppShell, Sidebar, TopNav. src/contexts/ - AuthContext, SidebarContext, BranchContext. src/hooks/ - custom hooks including useAuth, useProfile. src/lib/ - supabase client, config, utils. src/types/ - TypeScript type definitions.
